Archive master

Definition

Archive master is the authoritative preservation file retained with provenance, checksums, metadata and restore procedures. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align archive decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • 3-2-1 backup
  • Mezzanine master
